title: Sakthi Mobiles Business Suite
summary: A multi-branch suite for a mobile retailer: services, recharge, accounts and branch reports.
problem: After the first two systems worked, the shop grew to multiple branches. Each branch ran separately and the owner had no combined view.
solution: One suite that brings branch services, recharge transactions and accounts together, with branch-level controls and a combined owner dashboard.

features.title: Multi-branch
features.description: Each branch works independently; the owner sees everything.

features.title: Recharge transactions
features.description: Secure, traceable recharge handling across branches.

features.title: Combined reports
features.description: Daily and monthly numbers per branch and overall.

aiNote: AI-assisted code review and test generation kept a large codebase reliable while adding features quickly.

testimonial.quote: Their recharge platform simplified multi-branch operations. The dashboard gave us clear control over daily transactions.
testimonial.name: MK Logu
